query_text: Where can I order a birthday cake online?

messages.content: Where can I order a birthday cake online?

message.content:
You can order a birthday cake online from several retailers, depending on whether you want **delivery** or **in-store pickup**.

- **Same-day delivery/pickup:** Nothing Bundt Cakes lets you “order your cake online” and offers same-day delivery and pickup[1].
- **Custom cakes for pickup:** Kroger lets you customize a cake online and pick it up in-store[2].
- **Nationwide shipped cakes:** Piece of Cake ships cakes around the country and says to place your order online[3].
- **Next-day delivery:** Bake Me A Wish offers online ordering with cake delivery to the door, including next-day shipping for some cakes[4].
- **Custom birthday cakes locally:** Blue Sheep Bake Shop offers birthday cakes online, mainly for NJ-area customers[5].
- **Nationwide birthday cake delivery:** Milk Bar sells a birthday cake that can be shipped nationwide[6].
- **Pickup at Walmart Bakery:** Walmart lets you order custom cakes and cupcakes online for local bakery pickup[7].
- **Gourmet nationwide delivery:** Harry & David offers nationwide birthday cake delivery[8].
- **Nationwide shipping from a bakery brand:** Carlo’s Bakery offers custom cake ordering with nationwide shipping[9].

If you want, I can also narrow this down by **delivery**, **pickup**, **same-day**, or **budget**.
